transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Um… yeah. I guess what made me come in is that people have been noticing how I’m moving, which is kind of embarrassing to say.

Sometimes I’m really slowed down, like I’m moving underwater or something. It takes me forever to answer people or even get out of a chair. And then other times I’m doing the opposite, like pacing around my apartment and rubbing my hands, like I’m trying to shake off a bad call from work.

I don’t know if that’s the right way to explain it, but it’s been noticeable enough that I figured I should probably talk to someone.
How long have you been experiencing these changes in your movement and energy levels?

It’s been long enough that other people have started pointing it out, I guess. I didn’t really want to make a big deal of it at first, because I thought maybe I was just tired or stressed.

But lately it’s been noticeable — like I’ll be moving really slowly, almost like I’m underwater, taking forever to answer or even get up from a chair. And then other times I’m pacing around my apartment and rubbing my hands like I’m trying to shake off a bad call from work. I’m not sure if that answers the timing part exactly… but it’s been happening enough that I felt like I should come in.
How many days a week have these changes in your movement and energy been happening? Has it been nearly every day for at least two weeks, or more off and on?

Um… I think it’s been pretty close to every day lately, at least in some way. Not always the same — some days I’m more slowed down, like I’m moving through water and it takes me too long to answer or get up, and other days I’m more restless, pacing around or rubbing my hands.

I don’t want to overstate it, but people can actually see it now, so… yeah, I guess it’s been more than just off and on.
Have you noticed any periods where your mood was unusually elevated, irritable, or you felt extremely confident or energetic, even if others around you didn’t see it that way?

Um… I don’t think so. Not really in that way.

I mean, I can get irritable sometimes, but I think that’s just normal stress, you know? I wouldn’t say I’ve had times where I felt unusually amazing or super confident or like I had tons of energy. If anything, that doesn’t really sound like me lately.

Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with friends and family?

Yeah… I guess I have noticed that. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, because I still sort of go through the motions sometimes, but things that used to feel like me just don’t really… pull me in anymore.

Like I used to sketch, or write little coffee notes, and I liked going on weekend hikes. Lately I’ll open the notebook or lace up my boots and then just kind of sit there feeling nothing about it. It’s not that I hate those things now, it’s more like the interest just isn’t there.

Does that make sense?
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating less than usual or losing weight without trying?

Um… yeah, a little, I guess. I don’t think it’s like a huge amount or anything, but most days I kind of forget to eat until late afternoon.

Then when I do eat, it’s usually just something easy, like toast or cereal, because cooking feels like… too much effort. And I have noticed my jeans feel looser than they used to.

I don’t know if that’s enough to count as a real change, but it has been happening.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you’re not worth much lately?

Yeah… I mean, probably more than I should.

I try not to make a big thing out of it, because everybody makes mistakes, but I’ll replay really small stuff from work or contract jobs over and over. Like if I replied to someone slowly, or missed something minor, it starts feeling like I let everyone down.

And then I’ll think, well… maybe that’s why I deserved to get fired, or why people shouldn’t count on me. I know that sounds kind of harsh when I say it out loud, but that’s where my mind goes sometimes. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you found yourself thinking about death or not wanting to live, or has suicide ever crossed your mind lately?

Um… no, I don’t think so. Not in the sense of wanting to do anything to myself.

I mean, I’ve had days where I’m tired of everything and wish I could just not deal with it for a while, but I haven’t been thinking about death or making plans or anything like that. I don’t want to worry you by saying it wrong. I think it’s more just feeling worn down than actually not wanting to live.
Have these symptoms of slowed or restless movement, low mood, and loss of interest been present most days for at least two weeks in a row, without a break?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, not every single minute of every day, but most days, yes.

If I’m being honest, it’s been going on a lot longer than two weeks. More like… a couple years now, maybe a little over two years. There are times where it eases up some and I can kind of function better, so I don’t want to make it sound like it’s constant nonstop. But it doesn’t really fully go away for very long.

So… yeah, I’d say it’s been there most days, with just brief breaks.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things for two years or more without a break?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to exaggerate it, but the down part has been there for about two years now—maybe two years and a month.

There have been little stretches where it eases up and I seem more okay, so I’m not sure if that counts as “without a break.” But it never really lifts for long. It’s more like it gets quieter for a bit and then comes back.
Before this current period of feeling down that's been going on for about two years, did you ever have another time where you felt similarly down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?

I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve had rough patches before, like anyone, but I don’t know that I’d call them the same as this or say they lasted two full weeks.

Nothing really stands out to me as a clear separate period before this. I don’t want to say no if I’m just not remembering right, but… as far as I can tell, not really.
